name: Spectral Sail
body:
School evocation [force]; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a small swatch of canvas)

EFFECT

Range see text
Area see text
Duration 3 hrs./level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

If a ship has lost one of its sails, this spell can save the day by creating a shimmering sail of pure magical energy that attaches itself to the yardarm indicated by the caster. The spectral sail performs precisely like a standard sail.
